hp.special: the thrall has a number of Hit Dice (d8s) equal to your Necromancer level

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The thrall can move through other creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Undying Bond
entries: Add your Proficiency Bonus to any ability check or saving throw the thrall makes.

action.name: Invisibility (3/Day)
entries: The thrall casts the {@spell Invisibility} spell on itself, requiring no spell components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability. The spell also ends early immediately after the thrall takes any action other than Dash.

hp.special: the thrall has a number of Hit Dice (d8s) equal to your Necromancer level

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Small creature. The swarm can only regain Hit Points through Necromantic Formulas, by expending its Hit Point Dice, and through the Undead Fortress feature.

trait.name: Undying Bond
entries: Add your Proficiency Bonus to any ability check or saving throw the swarm makes.

action.name: Rend
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit Your spell attack modifier} {@reach 10 ft.} {@h}2d8 + 3 plus Intelligence modifier Bludgeoning damage, or 1d8 + 3 plus Intelligence modifier Bludgeoning damage if the thrall is Bloodied.

action.name: Necromantic Mend (3/Day)
entries: The thrall expends one of its Hit Point Dice and regains a number of Hit Points equal to the roll.

reaction.name: Shifting Swarm
entries: {@trigger} An attack roll hits the swarm.
{@response} The swarm gains Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage against the triggering attack.
